verdict.rationale: Gusto's own announcement says owners can connect Gusto to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools to ask questions about payroll and teams, prep payroll and generate reports, with every change approved before it is final. It also cites an MCP server, a multi-client MCP for firms, and Gus, an AI assistant that answers questions and guides benefits enrollment. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond press-release claims, any independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works, and detail on which actions beyond payroll prep and reporting can be performed conversationally.
